## Darknet.scp() method

Copies the given script to the target server. The target server has to be connected to the current server and have been authenticated.

**Signature:**

```typescript
scp(files: string | string[], destination: string, password: string): boolean;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  files | string \| string\[\] | Filename or an array of filenames of script/literature files to copy. Note that if a file is located in a subdirectory, the filename must include the leading <code>/</code>. |
|  destination | string | Hostname of the destination server, which is the server to which the file will be copied. |
|  password | string | Password to authenticate with the destination server. |

**Returns:**

boolean

## Remarks

RAM cost: 0.6 GB
